title: Redesign UI/UX with clean minimal design and remove false face detection warnings

requirements.text: Redesign the overall UI layout with a minimal, modern design approach using better spacing, consistent typography, soft colors, and a structured grid system. Apply card-based sections with rounded corners and subtle shadows throughout all components to create a professional, distraction-free look.

quotes: Redesign and improve the overall UI/UX of the FocusGuard website to make it clean, modern, and distraction-free. Follow a minimal design approach with better spacing, consistent typography, soft colors, and a structured layout. Use a simple grid system, card-based sections, rounded corners, and subtle shadows to create a professional look.

acceptanceCriteria: All components use consistent spacing scale and typography
Card-based sections have rounded corners and subtle shadows
Grid layout system applied for structured content arrangement
Soft color palette used throughout the interface
Visual clutter reduced with cleaner component designs

requirements.text: Reduce visual clutter across all components by removing unnecessary text, alerts, and always-visible elements. Simplify the interface to create a calm, focused environment suitable for studying.

quotes: Reduce visual clutter by removing unnecessary text, alerts, and always-visible elements. Keep the interface calm and focused to match a study environment.

acceptanceCriteria: Unnecessary text and redundant labels removed
Non-essential alerts and warnings minimized
Interface maintains calm, minimal aesthetic
Only essential information displayed during study sessions

requirements.text: Create a strong hero section on the homepage with a prominent headline, the FocusGuard tagline, and a clear 'Start Focus Session' call-to-action button that navigates to the timer page.

quotes: Improve the homepage with: A strong hero section with headline, tagline, and 'Start Focus Session' button

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section prominently displays FocusGuard headline
Tagline 'Stay Present. Stay Disciplined. Stay Ahead.' visible in hero
'Start Focus Session' button clearly visible and functional
Hero section creates strong visual impact as landing point

requirements.text: Add clear feature cards to the homepage showcasing the four main features: Camera Monitoring, Focus Music, App Blocking, and Study Stats. Each card should have an icon, title, and brief description in a clean card-based layout.

quotes: Clear feature cards (Camera Monitoring, Focus Music, App Blocking, Study Stats)

acceptanceCriteria: Four feature cards displayed in grid layout
Each card shows Camera Monitoring, Focus Music, App Blocking, or Study Stats
Cards include icons, titles, and concise descriptions
Cards use consistent styling with rounded corners and shadows

requirements.text: Improve the Dashboard component to be cleaner and easier to read with better visual hierarchy, improved spacing, and organized sections that emphasize key statistics without overwhelming the user.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard layout improved with better spacing
Key statistics emphasized through visual hierarchy
Information organized in logical, scannable sections
Dashboard maintains minimal, uncluttered appearance

requirements.text: Implement comprehensive dark mode support across the entire application with proper color theming that maintains readability and the calm study environment aesthetic.
acceptanceCriteria: Dark mode toggle available and functional
All components properly themed for dark mode
Dark mode color scheme maintains high readability
Theme preference persisted across sessions

requirements.text: Add smooth, subtle animations throughout the application for transitions, state changes, and interactions. Animations should be minimal and enhance the user experience without being distracting.
acceptanceCriteria: Smooth transitions added for component state changes
Hover and click interactions include subtle animations
Animations are gentle and non-distracting
Animation duration and easing appropriate for study context

requirements.text: Remove the 'Looking at the screen' warning message completely from the camera monitoring system in the useFaceDetection hook and related components. Do not display this alert anymore. Only detect whether the user is present or absent using face detection without showing gaze-related warnings.

quotes: Update the camera monitoring system by removing the 'Looking at the screen' warning or message completely. Do not show this alert anymore, as it causes false detections and distracts users. Instead, only detect whether the user is present or absent using reliable face detection, without unnecessary warnings.

acceptanceCriteria: 'Looking at the screen' warning no longer displayed
Gaze direction alerts removed from UI
Camera monitoring focuses only on face presence detection
No distracting warnings for minor head movements or looking away

requirements.text: Ensure the redesigned interface is fully responsive and maintains the clean, minimal aesthetic on both desktop and mobile screen sizes with appropriate breakpoints and layout adjustments.

quotes: Prioritize simplicity, readability, and a distraction-free experience across both desktop and mobile.

acceptanceCriteria: Layout adapts properly to mobile screen sizes
Desktop layout uses available space effectively
Typography scales appropriately across breakpoints
Touch targets sized appropriately for mobile interaction
Minimal design maintained across all screen sizes

constraints: Do not modify Internet Identity integration in useInternetIdentity hook
Preserve existing camera detection functionality in useFaceDetection, useObjectDetection, and usePoseDetection hooks
Do not change backend session recording logic in main.mo
Maintain existing timer functionality in useTimer hook
Keep music player audio management logic intact
nonGoals: Adding new timer modes beyond Pomodoro and custom
Changing camera detection algorithms or thresholds
Modifying backend data structures or API
Adding new features beyond UI/UX improvements
